Title: Azure Security Center: Public preview updates for May 2021

Body.Content:
In May 2021, the following public preview updates and enhancements were made to Azure Security Center:

  • New recommendations to enable trusted launch capabilities (in preview)
  • New recommendations for hardening Kubernetes clusters (in preview)

See the May 2021 Azure Security Center general availability announcements.
